# Knowledge

- [assets](assets.md) - The shared module for the hotel's assets, with its parts; the assets folder sits beside config.json, named by assets.path.
- [dcr](dcr.md) - Copies the client's external_variables.txt and external_texts.txt into dcr_variables and dcr_texts, and writes them out for the client with the hotel's addresses, client version and short name.
